name: vidmuse-packaging
description: Package, recut, design, choreograph, source, review, and render VidMuse projects with focused product skills, 162 locally installable Shotcraft effects, narration-timed editorial collage generation, a bundled macOS Apple-silicon VidMuse CLI, and official HyperFrames domain skills.

interface.longDescription: A minimal VidMuse architecture with one router, two film owners, focused design and semantic-motion capabilities, a bilingual local library of 162 installable HyperFrames Shotcraft treatments with fail-closed recut policy, a gated editorial paper-collage generator whose clip lengths are planned from narration, a dedicated CLI skill carrying its macOS Apple-silicon executable, pinned HyperFrames domain skills, and the official talking-head recut visual protocol adapted to VidMuse media and review providers.
